decisions.why: Life Scope G3/G5/G7/E5/E7/PT/VS, Central Nursing Stations, Hemodynamic Unit, NMT Module and Multi Gas Unit are high-acuity ICU/OR/anaesthesia-grade multiparameter monitors and monitoring infrastructure, matching specialist monitoring (Mindray Benevision N-series/High Acuity precedent), not routine ward spot-checks

NIBP cuffs, disposable electrodes, SpO2/CO2 sensors, reusable and single-patient-use probes, masks, patient circuit, disposable pads and paste/gel are sensors, cables and consumables used with the Pms monitors, matching Spacelabs Healthcare Ltd's precedent for the same shape of division
